criteria.support_condition: Comparable longitudinal evaluations establish worsening monitoring, behavioral control, and harmful behavior across a sufficiently representative set of generative AI systems.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable, sufficiently broad evaluations establish stable or improving performance on the claimed dimensions. Opposing results on different dimensions would warrant a mixed assessment only where those dimensions are actually measured.
